description: Read current XRPL account state for one account, including balance, sequence, owner count, flags, and settings. Use this for current account state; use n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction or n9t2_xrpl_list_account_transactions for transaction history, and n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data for raw ledger objects.
